title: Garyaev healing people in wooden pyramids

tellings.quote: and he was healing people inside of pyramids. A wooden wooden pyramids that were

plain: Dave Rossi, a guest on Jesse Michels' podcast, describes the work of a Russian researcher named Peter Garyaev, drawing on a website about Garyaev's idea he calls "linguistic wave genetics." Rossi says Garyaev was healing people by placing them inside wooden pyramids. If true, it would suggest that shape alone can carry some kind of healing power.
